metadata.description: Self-contained marketplace for storymap-skill — a single Agent Skill for user story mapping (Jeff Patton style).

plugins.name: storymap-skill
plugins.description: User story mapping (Jeff Patton style): map a goal, brief, or backlog into a user journey and prioritized release slices with per-persona stories. Mine existing context and simulate persona handoffs before interviewing. Step 0.5 reconciles prior progress against tracker and code state; reruns diff and update the existing map. Shape release scope when it is open in Superpowers, gstack, or GSD, preserving framework-owned framing. Hand the selected slice, observable demo, and exclusions to the next review or planner instead of duplicating its workflow. Always produces design.md, storymap.md, and storymap.csv; Mermaid and ranked backlog files are local views when no issue tracker is defined. Reuse tracker taxonomy when applicable and prepare opt-in, user-run write-back for estimate, iteration, and status. Optional acceptance criteria, E2E contracts, and UX/architect role hints extend the map.
